messages:
Sam (new-hire): hi team - i'm on day 3 and trying to get the last bits of tooling access sorted. need staging + prod Console access and to be added to the feature-flag operators group so i can run canaries. who do i ping for each? :wave:
Jordan (platform): hey @Sam - congrats! for staging i can add you directly. prod is gated (training + approval). which email are you using for SSO?
Sam (new-hire): sam@example.com - that's the SSO. also curious which FF group name exactly so i can reference it in my onboarding ticket.
Anya (devex): fyi the group we use is `flags-admins` for full feature-flag control and `flags-viewers` for read-only. most new hires get `flags-admins` in staging, and `flags-viewers` in prod until they complete the safety checklist.
Priya (security): prod `flags-admins` is only given after the security orientation and a manager sign-off. please file an access request ticket in the tracker and tag your manager + @Lisa (people-ops). i'll review after orientation.
Sam (new-hire): ok, do you have a template for the ticket? want to avoid back-and-forth.
Lisa (people-ops): use this short template: 1) requested access and environment (staging/prod) 2) justification (what you need to do) 3) manager approval (cc) 4) training status. you can paste this in the tracker issue. i can fast-track once manager approves.
Sam (new-hire): thanks - filing now.
Sam (new-hire): ISSUE: "Access request - Console prod read + flags-admins (staging)"
Sam (new-hire): description: need staging admin to run rollout smoke tests for the new routing policy; need prod read-only to monitor first-week metrics. manager: Jordan. email: sam@example.com
Jordan (platform): thanks - i'll reply in the ticket with approval. @Anya can you add Sam to staging `flags-admins` after you confirm?
Anya (devex): yep. give me a min.
infra-bot: automated log - created access-ticket #ACC-7896 by Sam (sam@example.com) at 2026-03-23T10:15:04Z.
Anya (devex): done - added Sam to `flags-admins` in staging and granted Console staging role `staging-admin`. you should see it in ~30s.
Sam (new-hire): seeing a notification, thanks! how do i verify permissions quickly?
Anya (devex): quick check: run `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/users/me` and look for `groups` array. or open Console -> top-right avatar -> "Your roles".
Sam (new-hire): curl shows \"groups\": [\"flags-admins\",\"staging-admin\"] - good.
Sam (new-hire): one more q: if i need to run a destructive FF action in staging (kill rollout), any special process?
Jordan (platform): for staging destructive ops, just notify #eng-oncall and post the rollout id. for prod we require a runbook + oncall present.
Priya (security): also log the action in the compliance tracker (link in handbook). we get an email alert for any prod flag deletions.
Sam (new-hire): noted. filing the compliance step in case we move to prod later.
Lisa (people-ops): i've approved the ticket on my side once Jordan confirmed. Priya, flag for you to run the security checklist when Sam completes orientation.
Priya (security): will do. Sam, ping me after the orientation session and i'll schedule the short follow-up check (5-10m).
Sam (new-hire): awesome, thanks everyone! saved me a ton of time. :raised_hands:
Jordan (platform): welcome aboard. reach out if you hit permission weirdness.
Anya (devex): ping me if you want a quick tour of the flags dashboard - i have a 10-min recording too.
Sam (new-hire): appreciate it - would love the recording.
Anya (devex): sharing link in DM.
